title: Advanced Tax & Freelancer Planning 🧾
description: Freelancers, gig workers, aur Creators ke liye Tax, GST, Section 44ADA presumpive tax, aur ITR Filing roadmap.

cards.title: Section 44ADA Presumptive Tax 💡
cards.content:
Freelancers (Designers, Coders, Writers) ke liye Section 44ADA ek blessing hai!

Gross Receipts ₹75 Lakh tak: **50% income ko straight profit mano, baaki 50% flat expense deduction!**

Example: ₹10 Lakh gross income → Tax sirf ₹5 Lakh taxable income par lagega. Complex expense receipts ki tension zero!
cards.imagePrompt: Freelancer laptop workspace with tax shield calculation overlay, emerald green theme

cards.title: GST Registration Threshold ⚖️
cards.content:
**Services GST Limit**: ₹20 Lakh/year (₹10 Lakh in special states).
**Export of Services**: Upwork/Fiverr cross-border income is 0% GST (LUT filing mandatory).

Penalty Warning: GST threshold cross karke billing bina GSTIN ke karna 100% penalty trigger kar sakta hai.
cards.imagePrompt: GST certificate document with floating green coins and balance scale

choiceData.scenario: Upwork client US ka hai, ₹5 Lakh payment aane wali hai. GST step kya hoga?

choices.text: Normal GST 18% charge karke pay karwao
choices.consequence: Wrong! Foreign clients GST pay nahi karte.

choices.text: File LUT (Letter of Undertaking) for 0% Export GST
choices.consequence: Correct! Legally 0% GST export benefit unlocked.
